review.why: Produces a formal cited research report from open-web evidence, with depth tiers set by the time the user allows.
review.summary: For report-scale questions only: asks how long the task may run, then searches and scrapes with Firecrawl at a quick, thorough or exhaustive depth, optionally splitting by angle across sub-agents, and returns an executive summary, findings, contrarian views, open questions and a full source list.
strengths: Depth tiers tied to the time the user gives
Refuses quick lookups and top-N lists
Hands paper-based questions to the sibling literature skill
cautions: Needs a Firecrawl API key and the Firecrawl service
Instructions only: no scripts or templates beyond the report outline
Always asks a runtime question before starting
